_note: Peace Be Still's identity, and the only place its non-store sameAs is written. Each live store listing joins sameAs from site/config/store.json (orgSameAs in site/content/parts.mjs), so the listing URLs have one home. The Organization node on every page carries the same name, url, logo, sameAs and parentOrganization; scripts/entity-watch.mjs (weekly) fetches every sameAs URL and fails by name on a dead one or on drift.
name: Peace Be Still
description: A phone app for the end of the day: the King James Bible to read and hear, whispered Psalms for sleep, Bible chat and daily declarations. A great calm, every night.
